title: Chiropractic Advertising - Google Adwords for Chiropractors

facts.fact: The article describes Google Ads as a pay-per-click system in which Google receives a fee every time someone clicks on the ad.
facts.quote: Google Ads is a pay per click (PPC) system in which Google receives a fee every time someone clicks on your ad.

facts.fact: In the article's illustrative example, the vendor assumes each new patient is worth $1,000.
facts.quote: if new patients are worth $1,000 each, and you pay Google $6.50 for each click you receive

facts.fact: In the article's illustrative example, the practice pays Google $6.50 for each click.
facts.quote: and you pay Google $6.50 for each click you receive

facts.fact: In the article's illustrative example, about 15 clicks are assumed to generate one lead, and three leads are assumed to produce one new patient.
facts.quote: you will probably receive 15 clicks to generate a lead, and need three leads to produce a new patient

facts.fact: The article's example budget of $10 per day, or $200 per month when run only on work days, is assumed to yield about 40 clicks per month.
facts.quote: If you allocate just $10 daily toward Google Ads, or $200 monthly when run only on work days, you’re likely to receive 40 clicks a month

facts.fact: In the article's example, a $200 monthly Google Ads spend is projected to produce one new patient, for a stated profit of $800.
facts.quote: You paid $200 for the ads and received a new patient at $1,000, so your profit is $800.

facts.fact: In the article's example, a budget of $90 per day, or $1,800 per month, is projected to produce 280 clicks and 19 leads.
facts.quote: Increase your Google Ads budget substantially, to $90 per day or $1,800 for the month, and you should receive 280 clicks and 19 leads.

facts.fact: In the same $1,800-per-month example, the article projects about nine new patients per month worth $9,000 and a profit of $7,200.
facts.quote: That is about nine new patients per month, or $9,000. In this scenario, your profit is $7,200.
